master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE complete original commercial-game vehicle sprite facing RIGHT, premium semi-realistic painted illustration, readable dark contours, rich weathered natural textures and fine mechanical detail. Soft even daylight. White 1980s boxy delivery van with SHORT BONNET, sliding side door and roof rack, rear access ladder. Stacked unmarked cardboard parcels firmly STRAPPED to roof rack, parcels visible behind windows. Road grime. 5.4m long; tyre diameter0.78m. TWO axles. Road tyres: road tyre with smooth highway rib tread, painted steel hub. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, every tyre a perfect circle of the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. All road tyres fully visible, all hubs exactly one horizontal line, wheels fit centred round arches with natural clearance. Mechanically plausible cab: visible bonnet if conventional truck; distinct bonnet, radiator housing, headlamp, blunt bumper and round front fender with clean seams, no pointed wedge or fused shapes. Correctly scaled rectangular mirror on short rigid brackets beside A-pillar, no tangles or floating equipment. NO visible front grille face, NO three-quarter camera, only sliver of roof, level chassis and load. Original designs only, no real make or model shape copied, no badges, text, logos, emblems, watermarks, brand or sponsor marks. No snow chains, no ground or shadows, no checkerboard or colored halos. True transparent background, clean alpha in every gap, full vehicle with generous margins. Use natural full length; never compress the rig. PNG at least 1760px wide, detailed high resolution. CRITICAL FRAMING: draw the entire vehicle AND every rooftop parcel AND complete circular tyres SMALLER, inside the CENTRAL 80 percent of the canvas. A large transparent safety border must surround every extremity on all four sides. Nothing touches canvas edges. No parcel, rack, bumper or tyre clipped.

wheel.prompt: Reference role: ROAD wheels on attached master. Generate ONE matching road tyre with smooth highway rib tread, painted steel hub. Match weathering, rim and hub design. Absolutely circular tyre and concentric rim, hub EXACTLY centred on square transparent canvas with equal generous clear margins. Face-on side elevation, soft even daylight suitable for rotating sprite. Premium semi-realistic painted illustration, fine mechanical detail, natural dark contours. No body, axle, text, brands, badges, logos, chains, background, ground, shadow, checkerboard or halo. Native square PNG.

method: Built-in image generator. Generated body registered and masked inside measured road-wheel regions; unchanged non-wheel master pixels retained. Generated wheel silhouette circularized. Native painting retained without upscaling. Measurements and correction parameters in validation.json.

rejected_attempts.reason: Clipped parcels and tyre bottoms; regenerated with larger margins.
